summary.text: Jessica Ethridge is the Libertarian Party nominee for South Carolina's 4th District. She was the Libertarian candidate for lieutenant governor in 2022, and her campaign then described her as active in the Libertarian Party and a legal professional. Little other biographical information about her 2026 campaign is public.

paragraphs.text: Was the Libertarian candidate for South Carolina Lieutenant Governor in 2022 on a ticket with gubernatorial candidate Bruce Reeves, receiving 1.2 percent of the vote.

According to her 2022 campaign, she had been active in the liberty movement for nearly a decade, a member of the South Carolina Libertarian Party since 2019, a state representative to two national conventions, Greenville County party secretary and State Committee 2nd Vice Chair; the campaign described her as an activist, mother and legal professional.
Advanced from the Libertarian convention for the 4th District on April 11, 2026.

sources.title: Lt. Governor candidate Jessica Ethridge wins national endorsements
